description: Repairs r-dao-1-err-1/recordset-state-inventory: Sort "V DESC" over the rows left by Filter 'ID > 2' (three, four, five) gave the same order as ID ascending and so did not discriminate; GetRows was not captured element by element; the dynaset was opened read-only so Updatable read False. On a dynaset over T opened on a writable Database: read Updatable and LockEdits; GetRows(2), MoveFirst, GetRows() (all remaining). Filter 'ID > 2' put and a snapshot derived with OpenRecordset, read to EOF with Updatable; Sort 'V ASC' put (the Filter stays) and a derived snapshot read to EOF; Filter put to '' with Sort 'V DESC' and a derived snapshot read to EOF; Sort 'N DESC' with Filter '' and a derived snapshot read to EOF; each derived recordset closed. Asks the order and rows of a derived recordset under a Sort whose order differs from the ID order, and the GetRows arrays. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
